integrity: All finite groups are computed from exhaustive simplex enumeration and exact signed integer Smith normal forms, with mod-two reductions and differential identities checked separately. Assertions of originality and scientific value are self-review reviews, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact integral homology computations are only for bidirected K_(2,4) and K_(2,5). The all-width assertion concerns dynamical-module structure alone. No homotopy-type classification or all-width torsion claim is established. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Two-torsion in multipath complexes of bidirected complete bipartite graphs
